title: Scaling Discovery Requires Forgetting
abstract: arXiv:2610.20563v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Automated research with LLM agents has shown promising results in various domains. Through iterative refinement and scored verifiers, LLM agents are capable of discovering new ideas. There are different ways to scale automated research: let one agent iterate for longer, run several agents in parallel, or further let the parallel agents communicate and build on one another's candidates. However, we find that all three strategies eventually plateau as the agents accumulate history. Each agent becomes anchored to its own past attempts, making fewer and smaller edits. Beyond this point, additional budget brings little further improvement. In this paper, we show that the key to scaling discovery further is to forget. Periodically discarding the search state, including every agent's session and the candidate history, and restarting from the best candidate found so far, unblocks the search and pushes the same budget further. translated_title: 扩展科学发现需要遗忘
translated_abstract: 基于 LLM 智能体的自动化研究在多个领域已展现出可观的前景。通过迭代改进和评分验证器，LLM 智能体能够发现新的想法。扩展自动化研究有多种方式：让单个智能体迭代更长时间、并行运行多个智能体，或者进一步让并行的智能体相互交流并在彼此的候选方案基础上构建。然而，我们发现随着智能体不断积累历史，这三种策略最终都会陷入停滞：每个智能体都会锚定于自己过去的尝试，做出的修改越来越少、幅度越来越小。超过这个临界点后，追加的预算几乎无法带来进一步提升。在本文中，我们表明进一步扩展发现的关键在于“遗忘”：周期性地丢弃搜索状态（包括每个智能体的会话和候选历史），并从迄今为止找到的最佳候选重新开始，能够解除搜索的停滞，让相同的预算发挥更大的作用。我们实现了……（原文摘要此处截断）
tldr: 论文发现 LLM 智能体自动化研究的三种扩展策略都会因智能体锚定于自身历史尝试而停滞，并提出通过周期性丢弃搜索状态、从最佳候选重新启动的“遗忘”机制来突破停滞，在相同预算下实现更大的发现成果。
en_tdlr: This paper shows that scaling automated discovery with LLM agents plateaus as agents become anchored to their own history, and introduces a periodic "forgetting" mechanism that discards search state and restarts from the best candidate, unlocking further gains within the same budget.
